info.title: Projects with branches
info.description: Describes the API for projects with branches.\n\n**Project Type Compatibility**: Branching is **only supported for Software projects** (localization_files). Documents and Marketing projects do not support branching. All endpoints in this documentation require Software projects with branching enabled.

get.description: Retrieves a list of branches. **Project Type Compatibility:** - ✅ **Software projects** (localization_files) - *Only project type that supports branching* - ❌ **Documents projects** (paged_documents) - *Branching not supported* - ❌ **Marketing projects** (content_integration, marketing, marketing_integrations) - *Branching not supported* Requires read_projects OAuth access scope.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Return results starting from this page.

post.description: Creates a branch in the project. Before using this endpoint, please enable Branching in your project by following [this guide](https://docs.lokalise.com/en/articles/3391861-project-branching). Requires admin rights. **Project Type Compatibility:** - ✅ **Software projects** (localization_files) - *Only project type that supports branching* - ❌ **Documents projects** (paged_documents) - *Branching not supported* - ❌ **Marketing projects** (content_integration, marketing, marketing_integrations) - *Branching not supported* Requires write_projects OAuth access scope.

post.description: Queues a localization file for import and returns a 202 or 302 response along with a Queued process object. Learn more. Requires *Upload files* admin right. Supported file types. Please note that the 302 response code is not currently used, but in the future it will be returned if the same file is already in the upload queue. Requires write_files OAuth access scope.

data.description: Base64 encoded file. Must be one of the supported file types.

filename.description: Set the filename. You may optionally use a relative path in the filename (e.g admin/main.json), however keep in mind that path would become a unique part of the file.

lang_iso.description: Language code of the translations in the file you are importing.

convert_placeholders.description: Enable to automatically convert placeholders to the Lokalise universal placeholders. Defaults to true; if omitted, placeholders in the uploaded content are converted automatically. Set it to false to preserve the original placeholder syntax.

detect_icu_plurals.description: Enable to automatically detect and parse ICU formatted plurals in your translations.

tags.description: Tag keys with the specified tags. By default tags are applied to created and updated keys.

tag_inserted_keys.description: Add specified tags to inserted keys.

tag_updated_keys.description: Add specified tags to updated keys.

tag_skipped_keys.description: Add specified tags to skipped keys.

tag_parsed_keys.description: Add tags parsed from the uploaded file (e.g. Structured JSON per-key tags) to the corresponding keys.

replace_modified.description: Enable to replace translations, that have been modified (in the file being uploaded).

replace_metadata.description: Structured JSON only. Enable to replace key metadata (tags, notes, character limit) with the values from the uploaded file. Tags added manually (via the editor, bulk actions, tasks or connectors) are preserved; only tags previously set by a file upload are replaced. Defaults to false.

slashn_to_linebreak.description: Enable to replace \n with a line break.

keys_to_values.description: Enable to automatically replace values with key names.

distinguish_by_file.description: Enable to allow keys with similar names to coexist, in case they are assigned to different filenames.

apply_tm.description: Enable to automatically apply 100% translation memory matches. This option will take priority over use_automations if set to true.

use_automations.description: Whether to run automations for this upload.

hidden_from_contributors.description: Enable to automatically set newly created keys as "Hidden from contributors".

cleanup_mode.description: Enable to delete all keys with all language translations that are not present in the uploaded file. You may want to make a snapshot of the project before importing new file, just in case.

custom_translation_status_ids.description: Custom translation status IDs to be added to translations. By default statuses are applied to created and updated translations.

custom_translation_status_inserted_keys.description: Add specified custom translation statuses to inserted keys.

custom_translation_status_updated_keys.description: Add specified custom translation statuses to updated keys.

format.description: File format (e.g. json, strings, xml). Must be file extension of any of the file formats we support.

filter_task_id.description: Apply import results as a part of a task. Available only for offline_xliff file format.

title.description: Set a human-readable title for the uploaded file, displayed in the UI instead of the filename. Maximum 256 characters. Relevant for Marketing and support (M&S) project types only.

post.description: Exports project files as a .zip bundle. Generated bundle will be uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket, which will be stored there for 1 month available to download. As the bundle is generated and uploaded you would get a response with the URL to the file. Requires *Download files* admin right. There are two ways to group keys by filenames when you are exporting - either all keys to a single file per language or use the previously assigned filenames. Learn more. Requires read_files OAuth access scope. *Please note: Starting June 1st, 2025, this endpoint will be limited to projects with under 10,000 key-language pairs, for more details See our API limits page*

delete.description: Deletes a file and its associated keys from the project. **Project Type Compatibility:** - ❌ **Software projects** (localization_files) - *File deletion not supported for Software projects* - ❌ **Documents projects** (paged_documents) - *Branching not supported for Documents projects* - ❌ **Marketing projects** (content_integration, marketing, marketing_integrations) - *Branching not supported for Marketing projects* **Note:** This endpoint requires branching support, which is only available for Software projects. However, Software projects do not support file deletion. This creates a logical conflict - this endpoint may not be practically usable. Requires write_files OAuth access scope.

get.description: Lists all keys in the project. This endpoint supports cursor pagination for better performance with large datasets. When using cursor pagination, the response will include a nextCursor value in the response headers when more data is available. Continue making requests with the nextCursor value until no nextCursor is returned, indicating all data has been retrieved. IMPORTANT: We do not provide a content delivery network for your language files. Do not make a request to this endpoint every time a user visits your website/app. Instead, fetch the results from this endpoint from time to time, store them locally, and serve your visitors with static files/your database content. Alternatively, you may use our File Download endpoint with an Amazon S3/Google CouldStorage integration to automatically upload your language files to a bucket of your choice. Requires read_keys OAuth access scope.

Only applicable for tasks with task_type set to automatic_translation in projects with segmentation enabled. When false, only empty segments will be translated. This parameter can only be set during task creation and cannot be modified or retrieved afterwards. Defaults to false.

include_ai_score.description: Run AI scoring (LQA) on task translations once automatic translation completes. Only applicable for tasks with task_type set to automatic_translation and requires the AI scoring feature in your plan. Defaults to false.

translation_engine.description: Engine that produces the automatic translations: ai (default), deepl or google. Only applicable for tasks with task_type set to automatic_translation; for every other task type the parameter should be omitted. The machine translation engines (deepl, google) cannot be combined with save_ai_translation_to_tm or include_ai_score. Unlike ai, which skips languages it cannot handle and reports them in skipped_languages, a machine translation engine rejects the whole request with a 400 error when it cannot translate one of the requested language pairs. This parameter can only be set during task creation and cannot be modified or retrieved afterwards.

ai_words.description: Total number of Lokalise AI words allocated to the team.

provider_id.description: A unique identifier of the provider.

price_pair_min.description: Minimum total price per language pair. It's "0.00" if there is no minimum requirement.

pairs.description: List of language pairs and prices.

key_id.description: Identifier of the key of the translation.

modified_at.description: Date and time of last translation modification.

modified_at_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of last translation modification.

modified_by.description: Identifier of the user, who made last modification.

modified_by_email.description: E-mail of the user, who made last modification.

translation.description: The actual translation content. Pass as an object, in case it includes plural forms and is_plural is true.

is_unverified.description: Whether the Unverified flag is enabled.

is_reviewed.description: Whether the Reviewed flag is enabled.

reviewed_by.description: Identifier of the user, who has reviewed the translation (if reviewed).

words.description: Number of words in the translation.

custom_translation_statuses.description: Array consisting of Custom Translation Status objects.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task, if the key is a part of one, or null if it's not.

segment_number.description: If segmentation is used then this is a segment number. If not then it defaults to 1.

ai_scoring.description: AI scoring (LQA) result. Returned only when include_ai_scoring=1 is passed. null if no score is stored for the translation; stored scores are removed when the translation or its source text changes.

score.description: Overall score from 0 to 100. Starts at 100 and adds the (negative) penalty of every issue, floored at 0: for example a major (-25) and a minor (-5) issue give 70. Intended as a signal for human review, not as a final quality verdict.

last_updated.description: Date and time the score was last generated.

last_updated_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of when the score was last generated.

issues.description: Detected issues ordered by severity, most severe first.

penalty.description: Points subtracted from the score for this issue (-75 critical, -25 major, -5 minor, 0 neutral).
